purpose: RiC-style typed relation-register slice (Marathon R11 lane BA; Wasananikornkulchai 2024, RiC-CM review — relation types only, not the full ontology). One appended line per typed relation: {kind: 'relation', subject: page path, predicate: one of part-of/has-part/superseded-by/supersedes/created-in-context-of/derived-from, object: page path, recorded: YYYY-MM-DD, note}. Append-only side register; whether named pages exist is reported as dangling, never enforced. Maintained with scripts/wiki_relation_register.py. This header line is the only line until an operator records a relation — seeded empty-but-valid.
